liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin** (1 review): Attendee says the opening raised the hairs on their neck [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Terrapin**: back after 45 archived shows (473 days); rare: 6 archived performances [13]
- **high time**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 13 archived performances [13]
- **mama tried**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [13]
- **mama pause**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **mama lovelight**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **spanish jam**: back after 59 archived shows (570 days); rare: 8 archived performances [13]
- **bobby speaks**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **one saturday night**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]

## The recordings

- **deadco2019-06-15.me66s_mixpre6** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is decent, but Oteil sits low in the mix while the drummers and Weir sound high and tinny; Reviewer rates the recording itself highly, four stars, but the band's energy poorly [2][7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended both Wrigley nights with a girlfriend and was blown away by the playing [6]
- Attendee recalls amazing energy at the show, despite earlier skepticism about post-Dead lineups [8]
- Reviewer finds this one of the least enjoyable post-Grateful Dead lineups, with songs too slow, and says it's not just this show [2]
- Reviewer hears the band as tighter than ever, though sometimes over-experimenting with reworked songs [3]
- Reviewer wants to dance as at Citi Field or Foxborough shows, but finds the reworked songs' pace not danceable [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2019-06-15.me66s_mixpre6**: taped by taper jon; source: audience [1]. Also: Chain ran into a Sound Devices MixPre6 recording at 24-bit/96kHz, then CD Wave, then TLH; Reviewer questions the board label since no patch is noted, arguing mics would be unnecessary if patched from the board [1][10]
